name: ToHeart2
source:
Following her graduation from middle school, [url=/c5320]Yuzuhara Konomi[/url] enters the same high school as [url=/c15061]Kouno Takaaki[/url], her childhood friend. As the new school year begins, they meet their childhood friend [url=/c5318]Kousaka Tamaki[/url], as well as many new accquaintances. Unbeknownst to the group, their encounters with each other will soon lead to many memorable adventures.

[Edited from [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=5821]ANN[/url]]
translation:
初中毕业后，[url=/c5320]柚原木实[/url]升入了青梅竹马[url=/c15061]河野贵明[/url]所在的高中。新学年伊始，两人与另一位儿时玩伴[url=/c5318]向坂环[/url]重逢，也结识了许多新朋友。他们尚未意识到，彼此间的这些相遇很快便会引出许多令人难忘的故事。

[改写自[url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=5821]Anime News Network[/url]]
